decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with no first project and no key milestone; three Wrenfield outreach emails (email:b7b0b250, email:b74abfd4, email:b1d86ae6) drew zero customer replies and no tickets, suggesting low engagement. One invite sent shows some intent, and 8 days remain on an active Team plan, so unaided activation is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

I know setup can be hard to get to in a busy week, so I'll keep this short. I can see an invite has already gone out to a teammate, which is a good start — in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the step that makes everything else click.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything about getting Bright Media's team set up.

Best,
Nadia
